title: Monodromy of Walrasian Equilibrium Prices: A Fixed-Preference Endowment-Redistribution Construction
abstract: arXiv:2609.21539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Suppose an economy moves continuously along a closed path of fundamentals and returns exactly to its initial state. A regular Walrasian equilibrium price followed continuously along that path need not return to itself. For every number of commodities $L\ge3$, we construct a closed one-parameter family of pure-exchange economies in which all preferences are fixed, only three individual endowments vary, and aggregate resources remain constant. Along the loop, two regular equilibrium-price branches are exchanged while a third returns to itself; at the end, every economic primitive is exactly as it was initially. The construction uses at most $2L+2$ consumers. We also provide an exact realization with at most $2L$ consumers in which all endowments are fixed and only one preference varies; the two families generate identical aggregate excess demand. translated_title: 瓦尔拉斯均衡价格的单值性：一种固定偏好下的禀赋再分配构造
translated_abstract: 假设一个经济沿着基本面的闭合路径连续移动并精确返回其初始状态。沿该路径连续追踪的正规瓦尔拉斯均衡价格未必返回到自身。对于每一种商品数量 L≥3，我们构造了一个闭合一参数纯交换经济族，其中所有偏好保持固定，仅三个个体禀赋发生变化，且总资源保持不变。沿着该环路，两个正规均衡价格分支相互交换，而第三个分支返回自身；在终点处，每一个经济原初要素都与初始状态完全相同。该构造最多使用 2L+2 个消费者。我们还给出了一个最多使用 2L 个消费者的精确实现，其中所有禀赋固定，仅一个偏好发生变化；这两个经济族生成完全相同的总超额需求。关键的实现问题是参数化的：经典的总实现结果保证了……
tldr: 该论文证明：即使经济基本面沿闭合路径完全回到初始状态，瓦尔拉斯均衡价格也可能不返回原值，并构造了在偏好固定下仅通过再分配三个个体禀赋即可使两条均衡价格分支互换的最小经济实例。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that Walrasian equilibrium prices need not return to their original values even when the economy's fundamentals traverse a closed loop, constructing minimal economies where, with fixed preferences, merely redistributing three individual endowments suffices to exchange two equilibrium price branches.
